_comment: #194: the 2026-27 postseason places each conference's standings show, transcribed from the owner's document
'2026-27 ECNL Girls Post-Season Structure' (Google Drive file below). Reviewed data: change it only from that document,
and keep `doc` as the document's own line (its PDF text drops dashes and opening brackets: 'U13U14' is U13-U14).
Rules apply in order for each age: each takes the `next` N teams not yet placed that have played (GP > 0).
`scope`: 'table' (default, the published table), 'division' (the top N of each division table) or 'pooled'
(the next N across all divisions together). `printed`: the place(s) the document prints, checked by
tests/postseason-rules.test.mjs; with `alt` the document prints two places and the walk lands on the later one.
`or: leagueCupWinner`: the League Cup winner can take this place. `opponent`: the conference a play-in is against.
Served as /api/v1/seasons/2026-27/postseason. The page's POSTSEASON_SEASONS lists the seasons that have a file.
